# Inferus Server Rules
The following rules apply on Inferus. Violating them may result in a warning, temporary ban, permanent ban, or role/job restrictions. When in doubt, use Admin Help.
Inferus is a [bold]roleplaying[/bold] server. We expect consideration, storytelling, and adult behavior. Admins can make mistakes and appeals exist, but low-effort chaos for its own sake is not welcome.
The server is [bold]18+[/bold]. Characters must also behave as adults. Inferus is ERP-[bold]friendly[/bold], not ERP-centric.
## Section 0: The Golden Rule
This is a ROLEPLAYING SERVER, where we expect a standard of story telling. Behaving in ways or attitudes that do not display consideration and thoughtfulness in some capacity may result in bans at admin discretion. You can appeal, of course, as admins are prone to mistakes as we're all human- but don't go around like a regular SS14 Clown throwing pies at people and then exploding them. That'd be nice.
## Section 1: Basic Rules
### 1.1 Admins have final say.
Admins are trusted in this community to keep it balanced and harmonious, if they deem an action shall be pushed against you, you will have to either accept it or attempt an appeal to the entire staff team.
### 1.2 Players and Characters must be and behave like the age of 18 and above.
We are an ERP friendly server- not CENTRIC, FRIENDLY, and expect all members to be adults as well as their characters to behave as adults.
### 1.3 Don't be an asshole
Bigotry is an automatic ban, and if admins deem your tone unruly, you may be banned at their discretion.
### 1.4 “Metacomming” is a case by case basis.
Just talking to your friends about something silly? Showing off screenshots of art done on station? Good! Exposing the antagonists, or threatening people OOC? Bad.
### 1.5 Do not Rule Lawyer anyone.
Some people may think that this is helpful- but Ahelping is encouraged. State the rule you think was broken in the ahelp, if you can, instead of threatening or abusing that player over rules.
## Section 2: Gaming Standards
### 2.1 Safe Zones include Cryosleep, Atmos, Arrivals, and Dorms
Attacking or dismantling these areas without approval from admins may result in an immediate ban from antagonists or greater.
### 2.2 Roleplay as a believable character
Would you believe someone is walking around going “googoo gaga” around here? No? Then don't do that! You are an adult worker of some variety, stick with that as a basis- you should have basic education.
### 2.3 Metagaming and Metagrudging are FORBIDDEN
If admins find you committing acts that imply metagaming (using OOC game knowledge) or metagrudging (harassing someone IC/OOC due to a personal issue) you are liable to being banned temporarily or greater.
### 2.4 Do Not abandon your roles
Even as an ERP friendly server, we expect that people do their part in the game. Administrative action may be taken if there are reasons to believe you are purposefully ignoring or abandoning your role and holding the job hostage.
### 2.5 Stick to your role
Please do not deprive other people of their jobs unless it is ABSOLUTELY necessary. The moment an engineer shows up, you will return tools, and leave the department, and other such cases with other departments.
## Section 3: Roleplaying Rules
### 3.1 Do not use familiar names
No celebrities, references to games, or other media as a naming convention for your character.
### 3.2 Silicon/Positronics bound by law must follow those laws
If you are a Cyborg or Station AI, please follow your laws as best as you can. Ahelp if you have questions or need help.
### 3.3 If you roll antag and don't want to play, ahelp to change.
Antagonists are important parts of the game, even if ours are not as intense as other servers. If you do not wish to play an antagonist on the current round, ahelp and ask for it to be removed or do your part to create a story.
### 3.4 Free agents and antagonistic ghost roles can be friendly
Please ahelp and alert admins to your intentions, and do not use this to powergame or otherwise. If you're found powergaming abusing this privilege, you can and will be banned temporarily or greater.
### 3.5 If you are NOT an antagonist, do not behave as such
Self-antagging is strictly prohibited. Exceptions can be made, if it's interpersonal drama or light crimes such as trespass, vandalism, etc. Do not act as a proper antag which would include initiating with security negatively.
### 3.6 Security are people too
IC and OOC inflammatory comments towards security can be issued warnings. Make the game fun for everyone, only antagonists are allowed to be inflammatory specifically in character.
### 3.7 Metashields are non-existent here
So long as your character can believably understand, know, or has experience with antagonists, there are no limits to knowing about nonstandards for their job.
### 3.8 Suicide Roleplay is Convoluted
You're allowed to do so so long as you keep it respectful and within the confines of the chosen few you've decided to affect WITH CONSENT. If this is done without someone's consent around them, you can be noted or otherwise. Please avoid sensitive topics around people if they ask you to.
## Section 4: Erotic Roleplay and Themes
### 4.1 We are ERP FRIENDLY, not ERP CENTRIC
We allow ERP to an extent so long as everyone's consent is respected and followed. Please do not include multiple people into your sexual encounters unless consent is granted.
### 4.2 Public sex is allowed with subtle emotes
You are allowed to openly have sex, or have areas self designated as NSFW around the station so long as you use subtle emotes and respect people's boundaries.
### 4.3 Kinkshaming is prohibited
While we are not centralizing on ERP, we hope to harbor a respectful community in which kinkshaming does not conduct that. Keep it out of this server or be removed from the Community- not just the game.
### 4.4 Regarding extreme or triggering kinks…
Consensual non consent and other hard content is allowed on the server BUT don't communicate over comms regarding the topic, and only tell security if they are okay with topics like this, and keep it out of station or character records to prevent discomfort. Plan ahead!
### 4.5 Do not abuse Safe Zones or 4.2
These safe zones are places where you may ERP, but you cannot abuse these areas such as dorms or cryosleep for antagonistic behaviors or gatekeep those areas from others. If you are asked to move, you will move if you are not already in a dorm.
### 4.6 Antagging and ERP
If you plan on using ERP to your advantage as an antag, please check consent with other players first and foremost. Secondly, do not go overboard with this- luring someone is cool and fun and a great story! Desecrating the captain's corpse is. It sure is.
### 4.7 Headsets for All
PLEASE, no matter your role, keep your headsets on during ERP. This is a safety thing more than a punishing thing, but if you are command, security, or medical you may be given a warning or greater.
## Section 5: Command Standards
### 5.1 Command and Security are held at higher standards and more scrutiny.
Like every MRP+ server ever, we expect Command and Security to especially uphold both server rules and Standard Operating Procedure laws.
### 5.2 Command and Security are expected to be available for their department at all times.
Private RP sessions should be performed with people while you are not performing a critical station role, but if you insist, you should be capable of dropping the scene.
### 5.3 Being demoted from your position may trigger an investigation by “Central Command.”
This may result in a temporary or permanent role ban. This does also include that command demotion be filed and faxed to Central Command however, if there is a lack thereof please feel free to ahelp against unlawful demotion.
